# Palm Casual

> > Palm Casual is a factory-direct outdoor and patio furniture retailer serving Florida, Georgia, South Carolina, and North Carolina with beach-ready and coastal décor solutions.

Palm Casual specializes in outdoor furniture for coastal living, offering showrooms across the Southeast including Jacksonville, Orlando, Myrtle Beach, Fort Myers Beach, and Atlanta. The company provides buying guides, style comparisons, and trend insights for homeowners seeking quality patio furniture at factory-direct prices.
